ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram, the centre of the circle is $O.$ The area of the shaded region is $20\%$ of the area of the circle. What is the value of $x?$ <image1>
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the image there is a circle, with the center labeled O. The gray shaded part is a sector enclosed by two radii starting from O and a circular arc, and the central angle of the sector is labeled x°. Then reason: The problem says the area of the shaded region is 20% of the area of the whole circle. The proportion of the sector area to the circle area is equal to the proportion of its central angle to 360°, so x/360 = 20% = 0.20. Solving gives x = 0.20 × 360 = 72.

method.method_draft: Read the image as a circle with centre O, where the shaded grey region is a sector bounded by two radii from O to the circle and the included central angle is labeled x°. Read from the text that the shaded region has area 20% of the whole circle. Use the sector-area relation: sector area / circle area = central angle / 360°. Set x/360 = 0.20 and solve to get x = 72.
method.CoT_raw:

再推理：题目说阴影区域面积是整个圆面积的 20%。扇形面积占圆面积的比例等于其圆心角占 360° 的比例，所以 x/360 = 20% = 0.20。解得 x = 0.20 × 360 = 72。
